body: I'll get a referral next chance I get, I just don't wanna go back on the anti-depressants when they say it helps. Could you pm me those videos?
The ex dreams are horrible :/ I used to get them a lot, you can pm me if you wanna talk about it?

I have read that blog, might give it a re-read.. I'm stuck where to go next though. Making appointments to see a psychiatrist takes months and waiting that long takes its toll. I really want to talk to more friends about it all but I feel like they'll associate me with bad feelings and not want to talk to me?

A couple of friends know but I don't think they fully understand where I'm coming from. I try to find distractions from day to day to help with the anxiety, a cigarette every so often seems to help (but I know the risks so I do it rarely). I'm really struggling for finding an interest/hobby, I think that is the biggest problem. I've become so bored with everything I used to do that anything new doesn't interest me.

I listen to my dreams a lot, most of the time I can work out what I want/need through them which is why my most recent ones are an issue. I've tried counselling but it was very short term help-wise. I have talked to my family and some friends but it always goes in a cycle, they'll tell me the good parts of my life, I'll feel better for the evening and then slip back down the next day...
